releaseNotes: Fixed ActivityResult / Fragment (<1.3.0) bug blocking Android 'Install unknown apps' Settings & file import pickers.
Moved updater Settings launcher to Activity-level registerForActivityResult with expanded system Settings fallbacks and direct Open Settings button.
Added Spend Heatmap (Month & 12-week rolling grid) and Category/Allocation Donut Charts across Home, Budgets, and Invest.
Fixed integer overflow, zero-decimal (JPY) scaling, calculator double-dot/operator bugs, and portfolio allocation rounding.
